capabilities: Pull notes changed since the last sync from Dinox
Push the current note, new notes, or selected text to Dinox
Organize synced notes into folders by type, zettel box, and date
Customize filenames and note content with Mustache templates
Append links to synced notes in daily notes
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not a general sync tool; it only exchanges notes with the Dinox service.
extras: Marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Stores the Dinox token in plugin settings and contacts dinoai.chatgo.pro and aisdk.chatgo.pro; the README states it has no telemetry, ads, or self-update mechanism. Bilingual English/Chinese documentation.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to exchange notes with the Dinox app, so users must copy content manually.

relations.evidence: Sync notes between Dinox and your Obsidian vault.
Requires the Obsidian core "Daily notes" plugin to be active.

summary: Two-way sync plugin that pulls notes from the Dinox app into the vault and pushes Obsidian notes back to Dinox.
